title: Farm Environment Plan
description: Farm Environment Plan (Canterbury (LWRP Schedule 7)), draft as at 2026-10-30. RCL platform template (draft, Claude research agent 30 Oct 2026); needs Josh's content approval (PLANS.md §11). Sources: [S7a] Canterbury Land and Water Regional Plan, Schedule 7 Farm Environment Plan (printed pp. 435-440), copy hosted by MHV Water <https://mhvwater.nz/images/Schedule_7_LWRP.pdf>; [S7b] Schedule 7 Farm Environment Plan - PC 5 (copy hosted by MHV Water) <https://www.mhvwater.nz/images/Schedule_7_Farm_Environment_Plan.pdf>; [LWRP] Canterbury Land and Water Regional Plan (operative, incl. PC7 from 10 March 2025) <https://www.ecan.govt.nz/your-region/plans-strategies-and-bylaws/canterbury-land-and-water-regional-plan/canterbury-land-and-water-regional-plan>; [ECANAUD] ECan: Information for auditors (Certified FEP Auditor Manual, November 2022) <https://www.ecan.govt.nz/your-region/farmers-hub/farming-plans-and-consenting/farm-environment-plans/information-for-auditors>; [PAC] HDLG/ECan FEP pre-audit check form (two versions, sprint drops) (sprint drop, not in the repository). Before publishing: Objective and target wording is from a secondary copy of LWRP Schedule 7 [S7a]; ECan's operative consolidated plan was not reachable from the sandbox. Plan Change 7 (operative 10 March 2025) amended Schedule 7 (springs added as a receptor; Waimakariri and OTOP nitrogen-reduction additions). Read the operative Schedule 7, correct any wording (notably 5E, which may now name springs), fill cant.s7.sub.waimakariri and cant.s7.sub.otop from it, then publish v2 with this flag removed. Part C sets the auditor and audit criteria only. Grades A-D and audit frequency come from the Certified FEP Auditor Manual (Nov 2022) and consent conditions, not from Schedule 7. Proposed fact types named in binds (risk_significance, fep_audit_grade, fep_audit_loc) do not exist yet; PL8/PL10 add them or bind elsewhere.

parts.title: About this plan
parts.guidance: Who prepared the plan, which version this is, and which Schedule 7 route it follows.

nodes.title: Plan details
nodes.guidance: Schedule 7 allows either its own default content (Part B) or an industry template ECan's Chief Executive has approved. Say which this plan uses.

nodes.title: Plan summary and farm story
nodes.guidance: A short summary of the plan and the farm's story and vision. Not required, but it makes the plan readable.

parts.title: Property details
parts.guidance: The property's address, owner, contact person, legal description and a farm identifier, plus the basic farm facts.

nodes.title: Physical address
nodes.guidance: The property's road address.

nodes.title: Ownership
nodes.guidance: Who owns the property (person, company or trust), and any lessee.

nodes.title: Contact person
nodes.guidance: The named person ECan and the auditor contact about this plan.

nodes.title: Legal description
nodes.guidance: The legal description of each parcel, owned and leased.

nodes.title: Farm identifier
nodes.guidance: A farm identifier for the property, e.g. the ECan farm or Farm Portal identifier, a dairy supply number, or GPS coordinates of the farm entrance.

nodes.title: Farm areas and land use
nodes.guidance: Areas in hectares and what the farm is used for.

nodes.title: Responsibility for the plan
nodes.guidance: The person responsible for putting this plan into practice, and the owner's commitment. The auditor expects this person at the audit.

fields.label: Person responsible for implementing the plan

parts.title: Maps
parts.guidance: A map or aerial photo of the property showing the items Schedule 7 lists. Mark 'none on this farm' rather than leaving an item off.

nodes.title: Farm map
nodes.guidance: All of Schedule 7 item 2 on one or more maps.

fields.label: Boundaries of the property or the land in the farming enterprise
Boundaries of the main land management units
Permanent or intermittent rivers, streams, lakes, drains, ponds and wetlands

parts.title: Resource consents
parts.guidance: Every resource consent ECan has granted for the property or farming enterprise.

nodes.title: ECan resource consents
nodes.guidance: List every ECan consent (CRC numbers) held for the property, not just the ones about nutrients.

parts.title: Land management units
parts.guidance: The main land management units shown on the map, with their inherent vulnerabilities. Nutrient budgets are reported for each one.

nodes.title: Land management unit
nodes.guidance: Code, name, area and a description of soils, slope, irrigation and use.

nodes.title: Inherent vulnerabilities
nodes.guidance: How vulnerable this unit is by nature to each pathway.

parts.title: Effects and risk assessment
parts.guidance: How the farm's activities could harm water and how each risk is managed. Schedule 7 expects at least irrigation, nutrient and effluent application, stock exclusion from waterways, and offal and rubbish pits to be covered.

nodes.title: Risk assessment
nodes.guidance: One row per risk and land unit, rated Minor, Moderate or Major (or Not applicable), with how it is managed. Must cover: irrigation, nutrient application, effluent application, stock exclusion from waterways, offal pits, farm rubbish pits.

fields.label: Management area
options: Animal effluent and solid animal waste
Waterbodies (wetlands, riparian areas, drains, rivers, lakes)
Point sources (offal pits, farm rubbish pits, silage pits)

parts.title: Nutrient budgets
parts.guidance: The farm's nutrient budget, prepared by a suitably qualified person in OverseerFM (or another model ECan has approved), with nitrogen baseline and current loss, and the Farm Portal report.

nodes.guidance: Nitrogen and phosphorus loss for each land management unit, from the same budget.

parts.title: Management areas, objectives and targets
parts.guidance: Schedule 7 sets an objective and targets for seven management areas. For each target the plan must say how it will be met, in detail that matches the risk, the actions and good management practices with timeframes, and the records that will show it.

nodes.cite: LWRP Schedule 7 Part B item 5A, Objective [S7a]
nodes.fixed_text: Use nutrients efficiently and minimise nutrient losses to water.

nodes.title: 5A Nutrients: Target 1
nodes.guidance: Say what you do to meet this target, in as much detail as the risk on this farm warrants, and which records show it. List any action still to do in the action table with a timeframe. Mark it Not applicable only if the activity does not happen on this farm, and say why.

fields.label: Practices in place and how the target is met
Records kept to show the target is met
